# 0.9.1-beta01

> **Beta.** Tested on a real phone, but still report what breaks on GitHub. Installs as **Editotsu β** and updates beta03 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - Watch next on home: sequels of shows you finished and related shows on your list, with why each one is there. It takes Planned Anime's place
  - Search from home looks through anime, manga, characters, staff, studios and users at once; search from the anime or manga tab stays on that type
  - Search filters live in one sheet you can see at a glance, and the filters you set show as chips you can clear
  - Covers show when the next episode airs ("Ep 8 · in 2d") under the title
  - Episode count "New on the cover": the unseen count sits on the cover and your progress stays under the title
  - On a torrent, the seek bar shows how much has downloaded ahead of you
  - Redesigned extensions, downloads and openings & endings screens
  - Theme rows on a show's Themes tab: one line for the artist and episodes, play cue next to the OP/ED tag
  - The source picker's filters and sort open inside the picker instead of a sheet on top of it
  - Reorder extensions with a long-press
  - Search filters show the sort in use and a reset button, and set filters stand out
  - Genres and tags are searchable chips grouped by category instead of one long list
  - Discord shows a bigger pause icon while paused, without the "Paused" text
  - Discord shows "Reading chapter" while you read manga
  - Search filters show format, status, season, year, source and country as chips in the sheet, with no extra list to open
  - Openings and endings rows have a round play button again
  - "New on the cover" count is a small rounded square
  - Home rows line up: headers, covers and titles start at the same edge

- **Bugfixes:**
  - Home loads after signing in again: AniList's new rate limits no longer block it. The app sends fewer requests, waits out a limit instead of failing, and shows your saved home meanwhile
  - The ring around your own story shows on light themes
  - The loaded part of the seek bar is brighter
  - A locked player no longer shows play, pause and episode buttons when you tap it
  - Play and pause respond the moment you tap
  - Switching search between all, anime and manga no longer crashes
  - An opening or ending you leave before it loads no longer starts playing in the background
  - The player's top buttons stay in place while a theme is connecting
  - The update badge on the Extensions tabs no longer covers the tab name
  - The audio-only switch on the Themes tab shows clearly when it is on

- **Known issues:**
  - If the AniList sign-in page sticks on the security check, tap the browser icon at the top to finish signing in
  - A torrent you haven't played before can take a while to start on a slow swarm, and long seeks are slow
  - AnimeThemes can take up to a minute the first time you open a show
  - Not redesigned yet: the scanlator filter, episode options, the comments header, and the profile, activity and offline pages
  - The Degoogle'd build has no in-app updater
  - Pink light theme is low contrast in places
  - Picture-in-picture can show a broken frame after pausing, and has no seek buttons yet
